_comment: A combination skill (CallForAid plus Heal) that spawns two SoldierCompanions and one MedicCompanion, which heals the squad and its owner. Skill level raises their lifespan and loadout level; owner level adds their max health and power. The cooldown is at least as long as the max lifespan so only one squad exists at a time. An unlisted combo recipe. All values placeholder.
name: FieldMedics
